title: Dashboard snapshot (snapshots/sprint-<id>.json and backlog.json)
description: Shared schema for the sprint snapshots (snapshots/sprint-<id>.json, active and frozen) and backlog.json, exported by export_dashboard_snapshots.py. The top level only requires the fields common to both files, which is what the exporter's minimal structural check reads (top-level 'required' and tickets.items 'required'). The exact ticket shapes are $defs/sprintTicket (sprint snapshots) and $defs/backlogTicket (backlog.json); tickets.items accepts either, and the acceptance harness validates each file strictly against its own shape. Sprint snapshots also carry a top-level 'sprint' object (added 2026-10-01) from the tracker's Sprint Metrics tab; backlog.json has none.

refreshedAt.description: Local calendar date the snapshot was generated, YYYY-MM-DD. Kept separate from exportedAt for date-based dashboard calculations.

exportedAt.description: Optional RFC 3339 timestamp with UTC offset recording when the exporter generated the snapshot. Older snapshots may omit it.

source.description: Which workbook and sheet this snapshot was derived from, e.g. '03_Team_Enablement/daily_tracker.xlsx · Daily'.

tickets.description: One object per row of the source sheet. Empty array is valid (e.g. an empty backlog).

ticket.description: The exact Jira ticket key (e.g. 'APP-123'), preserved verbatim. Never blank — rows with no ticket key are skipped by the exporter rather than exported with a null key.

points.description: Story points. Always a JSON number (int or float) or null — never a numeric value encoded as a string.

doneDate.description: Sprint snapshots only. YYYY-MM-DD or null. Set only when the ticket's current status is Done; a non-null value on a non-Done ticket is a non-fatal exporter warning, not a schema violation.

addedDate.description: Sprint snapshots only. YYYY-MM-DD or null: the tracker's Added to Sprint date, i.e. the Jira changelog date on which the ticket entered the sprint (its Created date when there is no Sprint-field entry). Older snapshots may contain dates from before the approximation marker was retired. See DATA_CONTRACT.md section 2a.

items.description: Fields common to both ticket shapes. Each ticket must also match $defs/sprintTicket or $defs/backlogTicket.

sprint.description: Sprint snapshots only: the sprint's identity and date range, from the Sprint Metrics tab. Not present in backlog.json.

id.description: Numeric Jira sprint id, parsed from the leading digits of Sprint Metrics' 'Sprint' column.

state.description: Optional. Written in some frozen snapshots of closed sprints (for example sprint-12119); absent in the active sprint's snapshot and not guaranteed in frozen ones (sprint-12176 has none). The manifest, not this field, decides which sprint is active.

completeDate.description: Optional. YYYY-MM-DD the sprint was completed in Jira. Only in some frozen snapshots of closed sprints, like 'state'.

startDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD, America/Los_Angeles. Null only before the first af-daily-tracker-jira run populates it.

endDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD, America/Los_Angeles. Changes if the sprint is extended.

carriedOver.description: Passthrough of Sprint Metrics' 'Carried Over #', 'Carried Over %' and 'Carried Over Story Points' columns for the active sprint; never recalculated from the ticket list. null (the whole object) means not calculated yet (all three source cells empty), which is different from zero carried over.

ticketKeys.description: Optional ticket keys for filtering the lower dashboard section to carried-over work items.

removed.description: Tickets that left the sprint (moved to the backlog bucket or a later sprint), from the Removed From Sprint tab (af-jira-changelog-scan pattern 5). Absent or null = not tracked for this sprint; [] = nothing removed.

type.description: Exact Jira issue type captured when the ticket left the sprint; optional for older removed records.

classifications.description: Jira Classifications (customfield_11500), multiple values joined with '; '. null when none set.

note.description: Optional free-text caveat about this removal record, for example that it was reconstructed by hand after the sprint closed (present in snapshots/sprint-12119.json). The app does not display it.

sprintTicket.description: The exact shape of each object in a sprint snapshot's 'tickets' array.

owner.description: Assignee display name, preserved verbatim; null when unassigned. The UI groups null, blank and the literal 'Unassigned' as Unassigned.

status.description: Original Jira status, preserved verbatim (To Do, Open, In Progress, In Review, Done, or an unrecognized value — unrecognized values are never dropped or remapped by the exporter). The dashboard UI may choose to display 'Open' as 'To Do'; that is a display-layer decision documented in the skill file, not something this exporter does to the data.

type.description: Exact Jira issue type, preserved verbatim; null when the source tracker has no Type value yet.

classifications.description: Jira Classifications (customfield_11500), multiple values joined with '; '. null when none set.

summary.description: Exact Jira summary, preserved verbatim; not a plain-language rewrite.

lastSyncUpdate.description: Short ticket status and next step, up to about 200 characters; displayed in the sprint ticket detail table.

demoOrSpike.description: Demo or spike status: Candidate, Presented, No, or null.

cycleTime.description: Days from start of work to Done. Populated only when status is Done; null for every other ticket by design (the metric does not apply).

statusAging.description: Whole days the ticket has been in its current status, from the tracker Status Aging column (Done tickets: days since Done Date). Null when the tracker has no usable number.

statusAgingApprox.description: True when statusAging is approximate (tracker value ends in *, meaning days since created).

backlogTicket.description: The exact shape of each object in backlog.json's 'tickets' array.

summary.description: Exact Jira summary, preserved verbatim; not a plain-language rewrite.

dor.description: Well-Formed, Weak, Missing, N/A (Epic) (since 2026-10-02; older snapshots used Ready for Well-Formed), null (blank), or an unrecognised value; unrecognised values are preserved verbatim, never dropped.

days.description: Days in Current Status as a plain integer. A trailing '*' approximation marker in the source cell (e.g. '223*') is stripped; only the number is exported.
